findings.statement: Static and split branches unconditionally overwrite the supplied time_shift with None; active dynamic branch honors it.
findings.relevance: Full5 a5 uses the active dynamic branch, whereas single a5 uses static. This is an actual branch-behavior difference despite a shared engine.
findings.independent_work_here: Source/Git provenance verified; parent real-environment CPU probe is referenced below. It finds5119 nonzero shifts in original10K, static delta0 versus dynamic nonzero delta; None-shift outputs stay identical after the two-line candidate patch.

result.interpretation: Original active static path drops a nonzero time_shift; dynamic honors it. Removing two unconditional assignments restores the existing shifted formula, leaves every None-shift output unchanged, and leaves the dynamic branch unchanged.
result.limitation: CPU interface proof only. Existing trained checkpoint renders normally use time_shift=None, so this fix does not repair saved a5 geometry by itself. A controlled training replay is required to test a5 causality.

findings.not_proven: Original design intent, a requirement for identical static/dynamic self-supervision, and a unique explanation for the a5 reconstruction defect remain unproven. No GPU intervention was made in this audit.
findings.classification_note: The CPU probe establishes that the active static branch drops a supplied nonzero time_shift while dynamic honors it. No design document establishes that static must use the same self-supervision as dynamic. The old implementation may reflect a static-branch assumption; its original intent is unresolved. This is reproduced branch behavior and a candidate wiring defect, not an established a5 causal explanation.

findings.statement: Normal generic densification resets max_radii2D before evaluating the screen-size pruning predicate.
findings.failed_assertion: For radii[100,1], max_screen_size20 and no added children, normal densify_and_prune should prune the100px point by its screen predicate, but prunes0; prune_only=True prunes1.
findings.root_cause_status: Not established. This bug retains oversized splats; fixing it changes topology substantially and is not automatically an a5-hole fix.

findings.statement: Single preparation copies only a37 full PLY and keeps the original sampled scene PLY; it never transfers full nonselected a5 PLY into static.
findings.acceptance_weakness: The retained-seed audit requires only retained_after_target_exclusion>0; that passes even after a large reduction in known body support.
findings.classification: The saved identity_contract explicitly promises the original B temporal-static representation, not full dynamic-Ply support preservation. This is a measurable representation/input change, not a proven violation of the written recipe.
findings.minimum_validation: If full nonselected support preservation is required, add a CPU source-identity coverage assertion; a future matched isolated replay must separately test restoring real a5 support versus changing its loss branch. No such new run was started here.

findings.statement: The physical a5 is moving, but its static branch receives long-duration and low-velocity preferences plus static-only opacity resets.
findings.interpretation: a5 RGB branch weight changes from global1+dynamic5 to global1+static1. The static Gaussian model still has trainable time and velocity; it is not a frozen rigid background.

findings.statement: 10K→11977 improvement occurs during recovery after9K reset and continued densification/time localization; it does not cross12K reset or change SH degree.

earliest_saved_single_deficit.observation: At raw105, the blue foreground a5 upper-body/roof region present in GT and existing full5 B10K is not reconstructed in single smoke1K; single smoke2K and formal single10K also show the deficit. Low-step underfitting cannot be called a destruction event.
earliest_saved_single_deficit.limit: This records failure to reconstruct at the saved smoke1K output. It does not establish that a complete body ever formed and was then destroyed, locate a triggering update, or prove identical intermediate tensors in the independent formal run. The directly supported workflow bracket remains full5 to single.

findings.limit: The deficit is already seen in a separate same-contract single1K saved output before the first3K reset. Reset9K cannot explain its initial formation. No before/after9K rendered checkpoint pair exists in this audit.

findings.statement: All21358 a5 PLY points exactly reconstruct from actual LiDAR indices and per-frame pose; nx timestamps are correct, and1496 sampled a5 static rows have zero time mismatches.
findings.static_sampling_note: The transient np.random.choice on rebuilt LiDAR still consumes RNG. With initialization=False, actual returned static PCD is the existing points3d.ply after selected-only0.1m exclusion, not that transient sample.
findings.exclusion_note: The exclusion is time-agnostic, but independently measured a5 exact-match removal is0 for the actual selected a37 subset.

findings.statement: Selected-a37 NPS pixel domain has zero overlap with fixed a5 pixels; exact a5 ancestry has zero SGCM-region membership at initialization,10K and11977.
findings.limit: No claim that all indirect 3D parameter coupling is zero, nor that the extinct402 initial lineages never entered a region at an unsaved intermediate iteration.

caveats: Lineage membership records descendants of exact-matched initial a5 source rows; other source lineages can also learn the a5 appearance.
Projected-center/effective-opacity statistics ignore occlusion, covariance footprint and pixel transmittance; they are not actual rendered alpha attribution.
The upper35percent bbox mask is a fixed observed-pixel upper-body proxy, not a semantic roof annotation.
Two endpoints do not isolate the causal contribution of reset recovery versus densification, pruning or ordinary SGD.
